# REMAKE Beauty — AI Makeup Shade Finder & Skincare Barcode Scanner

> REMAKE Beauty is the ultimate iOS app that scans beauty product barcodes to expose toxic/comedogenic ingredients, hidden allergens, and provides perfect AI shade matching.

## Core App Features
- **Skincare & Makeup Barcode Scanner**: Exposes toxic ingredients, hormone disruptors, and skin barrier hazards.
- **Acne-Safe Comedogenic Checker**: Instantly screens for pore-clogging ingredients.
- **AI Spectral Shade Matching**: Calibrates for ambient lighting automatically to find the user's flawless foundation match.
- **Cosmetic Chemistry Dupe Finder**: Identifies affordable drugstore alternatives with 95%+ identical molecular structures.
- **Hard Paywall Model**: All features are secured behind a subscription ($9.99/mo or $49.99/yr via Apple IAP) following onboarding.

## Science-Backed Product Teardowns (Safe-Ingredient Analysis)
Our cosmetic chemistry audits expose popular products by analyzing comedogenic ratings, skin irritants, and biochemical hazards.

- [e.l.f. Halo Glow Liquid Filter Analysis](https://remake.beauty/products/elf-halo-glow-liquid-filter-acne-safe.html) — Is e.l.f. Halo Glow safe for acne? Exposing the synthetic fillers and pore-clogging risks.
- [Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask Ingredients Audit](https://remake.beauty/products/laneige-lip-sleeping-mask-toxic-ingredients.html) — Analysis of Laneige's heavy synthetic waxes, fragrance allergens, and lip-drying risks.
- [Dior Lip Glow Oil Safety Teardown](https://remake.beauty/products/dior-lip-glow-oil-ingredients.html) — Is Dior's luxury formula worth it? Highlighting fragrance sensitizers and synthetic oils.
- [Charlotte Tilbury Hollywood Flawless Filter Review](https://remake.beauty/products/charlotte-tilbury-flawless-filter-acne-safe.html) — Analysis of the heavy bismuth oxychloride and potential breakout triggers in this viral primer.
- [CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion Assessment](https://remake.beauty/products/cerave-daily-moisturizing-lotion-breakouts.html) — Breaking down why this 'dermatologist-recommended' moisturizer still triggers stubborn breakouts in oily skin.
- [Glossier Cloud Paint Acne Safety Review](https://remake.beauty/products/glossier-cloud-paint-acne-safe.html) — Is this popular liquid blush completely safe for acne-prone skin? An ingredient-by-ingredient audit.
- [Benefit The POREfessional Primer Analysis](https://remake.beauty/products/benefit-porefessional-primer-toxic.html) — Exposing the heavy silicone wraps (cyclopentasiloxane) that trap sweat and oil in your pores.

- [Drunk Elephant Lala Retro Whipped Cream](https://remake.beauty/products/drunk-elephant-lala-retro-acne.html) — Exposing why this thick moisturizer's isopropyl isostearate is a level-5 pore-clogging trap for acne.
- [Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow PHA+BHA Toner](https://remake.beauty/products/glow-recipe-watermelon-glow-toner-allergens.html) — Is the viral Glow Recipe toner breaking you out? Audit of synthetic fragrance and fruit extract allergens.
- [Supergoop! Unseen Sunscreen SPF 40 Teardown](https://remake.beauty/products/supergoop-unseen-sunscreen-toxic-filters.html) — Exposing the toxic chemical UV filters (Avobenzone, Homosalate) and heavy suffocating silicones.
- [Saie Slip Tint Dewy Broad Spectrum SPF 35](https://remake.beauty/products/saie-slip-tint-acne-safe.html) — Exposing the comedogenic rating of Saie's organic oils and checking if it's safe for sensitive barriers.
- [M·A·C Studio Fix Fluid SPF 15 Analysis](https://remake.beauty/products/mac-studio-fix-fluid-toxic.html) — Is MAC Studio Fix safe for acne? Looking at the heavy chemical filters and pore-cloggers.

- [Kosas Revealer Concealer Ingredient Audit](https://remake.beauty/products/kosas-revealer-concealer-mold.html) — The truth about Kosas' clean formula, checking preservative efficacy and mold contamination risks.
